title: Die autobiographischen Aufzeichnungen Hermann Weinsbergs – Digitale Gesamtausgabe
author: Hermann Weinsberg
institution: Abteilung für Geschichte der Frühen Neuzeit und Rheinische Landesgeschichte, Universität Bonn, with the Historisches Archiv der Stadt Köln
notes: Transcription of the three books of the Cologne citizen Hermann Weinsberg (1518-1597): Liber Iuventutis, Liber Senectutis and Liber Decrepitudinis, in Cologne German with Latin passages, each served as a series of long HTML pages (8, 11 and 10 files) with marginal notes. Everything dates from 1518-1597, so all of it is in period. No word count is given because the transcription is split into many words by the markup, so a reliable count could not be made. The pages use an old frameset layout; the site says some functions (editorial notes) no longer work and that a relaunch is being prepared. The home page shows 'Letzte Änderung: 09.04.2024'. A DFG project since 2002.
